page.overview:
Who is Jojo?

Jojo was also known to steal from the Fire Nation, often forcing her to block firebending attacks and retaliate with her own bending — part of Avatar: The Last Airbender.

Other known victims include the cabbage merchant and Katara, who attacked Jojo with her waterbending. Upon seeing Avatar Aang's wanted posters, Jojo became infatuated with him.
